candidates.change_summary: Replace the require guard so anyone can call withdrawAll by removing the ownership check.
Invert the require condition so only non-owners can call withdrawAll.
Change transfer target from provided recipient to the contract owner, ignoring the _recipient parameter.
Send half the contract balance instead of the full balance to the recipient.
Do nothing (remove the transfer) so withdrawAll no longer transfers funds.
Use call instead of transfer to forward funds to the recipient (semantically different due to gas/behavior).
